# SEPSIS OR SHOCK WITH SUSPECTED URINARY TRACT INFECTION

Consider empirical broad-spectrum antimicrobials and consulting Infectious Diseases if urinary tract infection is not strongly suspected as the main source of infection. Refer to Unclear Infectious Source for recommendations.

[Unclear Infectious Source](sepsis-empiric-therapy-site-unk)

---

References:

- Evans et al., Crit Care Med, 2021, 49(11):e1063-e1143.
- Mandell Chapter: Sepsis, Severe Sepsis and Septic Shock
- Rhee et al., Clinical Infectious Diseases, 2021, 72(4):541-552. PMID: 32374861
- Rhodes et al., Crit Care Med, 2022, 50(4):e413-e414. PMID: 34643578
- Sanford keyword: Sepsis, Adult
- Singer et al., JAMA, 2016, 315(8):801-810
- Up-to-date article: Sepsis syndromes in adults: Epidemiology, definitions, clinical presentation, diagnosis, and prognosis
- Trautner et al., Clinical Infectious Diseases, 2025, ciaf459
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU SEPSIS SUSPECTED URO SEPSIS
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC SEPSIS SUSPECTED URO SEPSIS
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Patients on general medical wards

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h M for 7 days](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-q24h-sepsis)

### Patients in the ICU or with a history of Pseudomonas

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h R for 7 days](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-q6h-sepsis-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h R for 7 days](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-q8h-sepsis)
< OR >
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h R,DI for 5 days](psjizid-ciprofloxacin-400mg-iv-q12h-sepsis)

### History of ESBL isolate

[Meropenem 1 gm IV q8h R,O for 7 days](psjizid-meropenem-1gm-iv-q8h-sepsis)

### History of MRSA, add to intravenous therapy above

[< ADD > Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R for 7 days](orz-set-abx-vanco-sepsis-15mg-kg-q12h-mrsa-nares-screening)

## ER/UC

### Patients transferring to general medical wards

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV ONCE STAT M](psjizid-ceftriaxone-2gm-iv-once-er-uc)

### Patients transferring to the ICU or with a history of Pseudomonas

[Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV ONCE STAT R](psjizid-pip-taz-4-5gm-iv-once-er-uc-ne-extinf-ci-cefep-metro)
< OR >
[Cefepime 2 gm IV ONCE STAT R](psjizid-cefepime-2-gm-iv-once-er-uc)
< OR >
[Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV ONCE STAT R,DI](psjizid-ciprofloxacin-400-mg-iv-once-er-uc)

### History of ESBL isolate

[Meropenem 1 gm IV ONCE STAT R,O](psjizid-meropenem-1gm-iv-once-er-uc)

### History of MRSA, add to intravenous therapy above

[< ADD > Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV ONCE STAT R](psjizid-vancomycin-15-mg-kg-iv-once-stat-er-uc)
